verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI with a one-line install script. It exposes a broad slice of the API as terminal commands in sandbox (the default) or production via `--prod`. It explicitly targets AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and serves as the foundation of AgentOS, with OAuth role-gated auth and interactive API exploration; a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in agent workflows.
